{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999
print('Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:', df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0])
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
print('Original rows:', df.shape[0])
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')
print('After deduplication:', df.shape[0])

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values (divide by 10)
print('Batch B count before correction:', df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B'].shape[0])
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10
print('Batch B count after correction:', df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B'].shape[0])

# Display final shape and first few rows
df.head()"}
